description: User clears browsing data through various entry points (Fire button, single tab burn, Duck.ai chat deletion, app shortcuts, automatic clearing)

name.description: The name of the application sending the event

version.description: The version of the app sending the event. Release builds are X.Y.Z; internal and nightly builds append the build number and channel suffix.

form_factor.description: The form factor of the current device

dev_mode.description: Whether the app is a debug build

platform.description: The platform the app is running on

type.description: The type of software sending the event

sample_rate.description: Sample rate for this event, between 0 and 1

is_first_daily_occurrence.description: Whether this is the first event completed with this feature name and status in the current UTC calendar day

name.description: The feature name for this event

status.description: The terminal status of the flow

clear_options.description: Comma-separated list of data types being cleared. Values: tabs,data,duckai_chats

browser_mode.description: Whether this clear applies to Fire Mode or Regular Mode. Absent for flows that clear both in one pass (automatic foreground/background clearing).

tab_type.description: Type of the active tab when the burn was confirmed. Only present for dialog-driven flows.

tab_count.description: Number of open tabs when the burn was confirmed, bucketed like the tab_count pixel parameter. Only present for dialog-driven flows.

total_duration_ms_bucketed.description: Duration of the data clearing operation, bucketed using the lower bucket boundary. Does not include process restart duration.

failure_reason.description: Reason for failure. Only present on FAILURE events. Exception class name, or feature_not_supported / tab_not_found when the clear ended without an exception.

step.web_storage_clear_success.description: true if the step completed successfully, false otherwise. The implementation swallows exceptions so it does not affect the overall outcome of the data clearing operation, represented by feature.status.

web_storage_clear_error.description: Error message (exception class) - only present if success=false for this step
